briefings.title: OMB Dir. Russell Vought testifies before House panel on Trump's FY 2027 budget request—4/15/26

people.name: Russell Vought
people.role: Director, Office of Management and Budget

briefings.tldr: OMB Director Russell Vought presented a FY 2027 budget proposal centered on a historic 42% increase in defense spending ($1.5 trillion) and deep non-defense cuts, while defending the administration’s controversial use of "impoundments" to withhold congressionally appropriated funds.
